gotchas: The form also requires a birth date, gender and country or region of residence; they are the account owner's to supply.
The nickname is a display name, not a sign-in name; the account signs in with the email.
The page has three submit buttons (Google, Sign up with Apple, Submit); the recipe's submit is the plain Submit.
Country/region and time zone default from the visitor's IP location (India through the proxy on 2026-09-29); set the country deliberately.

Submit stays disabled until every required field is filled and both agreement boxes (User Agreement, Privacy Policy) are ticked; they are image toggles inside labels, so click the image, not the label text, which is a link.
After Submit the page asks for a 4-digit code sent by email (an input whose name contains pincode). The code belongs to the account owner: hand it off.
